caption: The drawing depicts a single glass bottle with a rounded body and a long, narrow neck. The bottle is a translucent, yellow-brown color with a decorative surface pattern of raised, crisscrossing lines forming a diamond lattice. The bottle sits alone centered on a plain, light beige background. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller inset drawing of the same bottle, showing the object from the same angle but at a reduced scale, framed by a simple outlined box. The artist’s name, “JOHN DANA,” is written in small, uppercase letters near the lower right corner. There is a small, horizontal linear scale in the bottom left corner of the page.
title: Flask - Liquor
